The review loop

A draft is useful
when it can be checked.

01

Investigate the alert

Start from the monitoring trigger, then follow linked accounts, transactions, documents, and related ownership records.

02

Ground the draft

Generate a clearly labelled fixture or live draft that cites permitted evidence IDs and keeps missing information visible.

03

Keep the human in charge

Save a note, request information, or escalate. The prototype records the action and preserves the audit trail.
